work_item: Live-test harness debug/fix: scripts/test_tickets_run.py — run 30 real Freshdesk tickets through the cs-agent-team draft workflow, compare AI vs CS, fix template selection + grounding, iterate until clean. (Phase-4 local-PoC acceptance exercise; NOT the PLAN.md execution.)

completed_tasks.name: Diagnose template-wrong root cause (category-glob load + free LLM pick -> Custom-/cross-family codes e.g. F8 for Change_Product_Variant)
Deterministic _SUBTYPE_TEMPLATES map (sub-type -> allowed codes + snapshot files) from CODE-MAP-templates.md; constrain LLM to one real code; validate+flag
Grounding discipline in drafter prompt: no-assert-action, conservative-on-missing-data, no-order->verify (D-34), fit-complaint->B-codes; xlsx checker block
3 iterations of re-run + 3 checker agents (per category) comparing AI vs CS: errors 11->7->4, ok 5->13, 30/30 valid template family

Fix Selless 'no order data': root cause was wrong host (.dev->.com) + must resolve by ORDER CODE via /po/search->/po/{id} (ticket-do returns empty). Live grounding now returns po.status + per-DO status (TA/TO/DELIVERED) + tracking + variant

remaining_tasks.name: Let iter-4 finish (background task bstsjftm2 — re-run all 30 WITH live Selless grounding; selless=Y now)
Re-run the 3 checker agents on iter-4 output; measure error reduction with REAL order grounding (expect delivery-status G4-vs-G9 + no-order + amount errors to drop)
Decide on deterministic guard (strip assert-language + amounts, cap offer per template) for template-inherent-assertion residuals e.g. 7731646 G12
Final report of AI-vs-CS quality + reconcile src/config.py default to .com (see blocker)

blockers.description: src/config.py:123 selless_api_base_url STILL defaults to https://api.selless.dev/... (empty data). The runner was hard-fixed to .com, but the Selless MCP (src/selless_mcp via settings) + client.py docstring still point to .dev — the real agent-team grounding would also get empty data until config is reconciled to api.selless.com.
blockers.workaround: runner uses its own _SELLESS_BASE=.com; reconcile config.py default before the MCP path is used live

decisions.decision: Template selection = deterministic sub-type -> allowed-code shortlist; LLM picks one REAL code (reject Custom-)
decisions.rationale: User-chosen (over LLM-free-pick / load-all). Fixes wrong-family + invented template names.

decisions.decision: Selless grounding resolves by human ORDER CODE via /po/search -> /po/{id} on api.selless.COM
decisions.rationale: ticket-do mapping returns empty do_ids; orders DO exist on .com by order code. Earlier 'data provenance mismatch' conclusion was WRONG.

decisions.decision: Drafter never asserts an executed mutation / dollar amount; conservative branch when order state unknown; no-order -> verify/clarify
decisions.rationale: Matches RD-Q1 + D-34; reduced AI-vs-CS errors 11->4 before live grounding.

background_processes.what: iter-4 drafter: python -m scripts.test_tickets_run draft for all 3 categories WITH live Selless grounding
background_processes.note: ~10 min; writes .test-tickets-data.jsonl; was at 1/30 when paused (selless=Y confirmed)

next_action: Check background task bstsjftm2 output; when ALL DONE iter4, rebuild .cs-compare inputs + re-run the 3 checker agents (general-purpose) per category, then merge findings + rebuild xlsx and report the error delta vs iter-3 (4/13/13).
context_notes: The drafter calls the `claude` CLI as a subprocess per ticket (claude --print --output-format json). Runner stages: collect -> draft -> xlsx. Data: .test-tickets-data.jsonl (30 recs). Checker = 3 general-purpose agents reading .cs-compare/<cat>.json + CODE-MAP-templates.md, writing <cat>-findings.json. Severity merged into rec['checker'] and rendered as the xlsx Checker block. Classification (Customer_Request) already matches CS 30/30; the work is all about template choice + offer/assert grounding.
